summary: Berkeley County tower on the Monongahela dated 1935 (1929 in one list); removed in 2008; no source describes what remains at the site.

facts.status_note: Removed in 2008 according to the register and Eastern US Lookouts; no source describes what remains at the site
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (register); West Virginia Division of Forestry (Eastern US Lookouts)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1935 and the forest history lists a North Mountain Tower (1935) among the CCC-built towers, which supports 1935 over Eastern US Lookouts' 1929 entry. No other source read supports 1929.

notes_for_editor: Unresolved: agency (register says U.S. Forest Service; Eastern US Lookouts says WV Division of Forestry) and the 1929 date in Eastern US Lookouts. The forest history supports 1935 and lists the tower as a Monongahela tower, but describes no site. No source describes the site today; access left out. A search hit for a 1966 timber tower titled 'North Mountain Fire Lookout' (Ramblr) was not used: it could not be read and its description does not match this record. Register record name, location and status otherwise check out; no corrections proposed.
